description:
Replace the 5-tab MainLayout with a sidebar + graph canvas + inspector shell at the new `/graph` route.

This work should:
- sidebar: activity-first unified feed with entity-type filter toggles
- graph canvas: React Flow v12 + Dagre, Zustand graph store with highlight/dim/hide query modes, viewport persistence via localStorage
- inspector: desktop popover anchored to node (clamped to viewport bounds), mobile bottom sheet variant
- header: title, lens switcher (segmented control), settings gear icon, agent-run status dropdown
- implement 301 redirects from legacy paths (`/backlog/:kind/:name` → `/graph?lens=topology&select=:kind/:name`, `/scenarios/:name` → `/graph?lens=topology&select=scenario/:name`, `/execution` → `/graph?lens=flow`)
- new URL scheme: `/graph?lens=topology|flow|operations&select=kind/name`
- remove the 5-tab navigation (Backlog, Scenarios, Execution, Prompts, Settings tabs)
- settings and prompts demoted to modal/drawer accessible via gear icon
- BFS neighborhood selection on node click (type-constrained traversal)
- three layout modes: hierarchical (Dagre network-simplex), compact (Dagre tight-tree), grouped (custom lane-per-type)

This item is about the application frame and interaction model, not about finalizing all graph lenses.
name: swarm-manager-graph-workspace-shell
title: Replace the Tabbed Shell with the Graph Workspace Shell
